decision: ADR-052: Health-id apps/patient-web is the single launch frontend for www, staging and admin.*; product hosts for deferred modules are not deployed (launch module set D17)

api_route_closure.note: Every deployed Worker proxies all of /api/v1, so not deploying a product host does not close its API; the gateway answers 404 API_ROUTE_NOT_FOUND for a module outside the enabled list.

not_deployed.reason: Serves hid-system's legacy apps/ehr build. The EHR API is on at launch; clinicians use the Health-id provider workspace on the staging host. Serving any build on ehr.* needs its own decision.
Redirects the old OCR host to the Migrate host, which is not deployed (D17).

separately_governed.reason: TUF release repository; published only by the protected TUF publication workflow, not by a frontend deployment.
